{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check if any completed order has zero revenue (could indicate test)
zero_revenue_completed = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue'] == 0]
print(f'Number of completed orders with zero revenue: {len(zero_revenue_completed)}')

# Check if any completed order has very high revenue (e.g., 999,999.99) as a potential test indicator
high_revenue_completed = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of completed orders with revenue 999,999.99: {len(high_revenue_completed)}')

# Summary of revenue distribution for completed orders
print('\nRevenue distribution for completed orders:')
print(completed_orders['revenue'].describe())"}
